title: Dataset catalogs
instructions: The datasets are the sources listed in one catalog file the operator writes; without that file every tool fails and names the path it looked for. A local source lists files on this host; a ckan source is a public CKAN portal reached over https, and downloads go only to its own host or the hosts its resourceHosts entry lists.

source.description: The source id from the catalog file.

id.description: The dataset id, as catalog_search returns it.

query.description: Words that must all appear in a dataset's title, description or tags; letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', separated by spaces.

source.description: Search only this source id from the catalog file. Default: every source.

limit.description: How many datasets to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

offset.description: How many matches to skip, in source order then each source's ranking. Default 0, at most 10000.

source.description: The source id from the catalog file.

resource.description: The resource id, as catalog_describe returns it.

destination.description: The file to write, relative to the server's working directory; its directory must exist.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing destination file. Default false.

maxBytes.description: Stop and keep nothing past this many bytes. Default and most 2147483648.
